assets.summary: Eliminate repetitive auth and error boilerplate in Next.js App Router API routes using a withAuth wrapper
strategy: Create a withAuth wrapper that handles user authentication and error catching
Replace duplicated requireAuth checks plus null guard and try/catch in each route

assets.summary: withAuth wrapper for Next.js App Router that cuts API route boilerplate by half with centralized auth and error handling
assets.content: The withAuth function wraps Next.js App Router route handlers. It automatically authenticates via requireAuth and catches exceptions. Usage: export const GET = withAuth(async ({ user }) => { ... }). Benefits: eliminates boilerplate, consistent errors, centralized logging.
